arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/how-it-works.md'; s=open(p).read()
a="- pi reads `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Write your commit format there."
b="- Write your commit format in `AGENTS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`. pi reads these files with its tools, as it reads the rest of your repository. pi-action does not add them to the prompt."
assert a in s; s=s.replace(a,b); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
tail -12 docs/how-it-works.md
